name: Hermes Ludwig
source:
Gry’s assistant who does everything for him no questions asked. Should not be underestimated despite looking frail. No one knows what emotions are hidden behind these soulless eyes, besides unbreakable loyalty. Far more intelligent than Gry, except maybe for that one poorly thought-out choice to be his servant.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=50143]Lemma Soft[/url]]
